caption: The drawing shows a single metal spoon depicted in two views against an off-white or beige background. The top view in the drawing displays the spoon from above, revealing an elongated, oval-shaped bowl with a pointed tip and a slightly concave surface, as well as a long, flat handle that gradually widens toward the end, featuring an indented line detail near the tip of the handle. The second view, positioned below the first, shows the same spoon in profile or side view, highlighting its shallow bowl and gently curved handle. The spoon is rendered in shades of gray with subtle highlights and shadows to suggest reflective metal. There are no other objects or background details, and the only visible text is located to the lower right corner, reading “Wm. A. Ludwig.”
title: Bishop Hill: Small Spoon
